chapters.question: How does desired behavior become a training sequence?
diagnosed_gaps: SFT purpose compressed behind audit rules
Template function and collator were assumed
Repeated red/END IDs obscure positional target ownership
Prompt masking and stopping need one controlled example
changes: Reworked opening around copy red → red → END
Added runnable existing encoder listing
Promoted repeated-ID producer/target table
Added adjacent prediction/reference reasoning for ownership and packed independence
Connected teacher/student synthetic data to later selection
reuse: Existing Day11 ownership, packing and10/90 mixture figures; no regenerated assets
chapters.controlled_change: Remove the assistant END target, or allow cross-segment attention; interpretation distinguishes direct loss from shared/context gradients
limitations: Symbolic IDs are not Qwen serialization
Full transcript supervision is a distinct objective, not automatically a broken assistant
A teacher response does not transfer its hidden computation

chapters.question: Why can the right answer prefix still fail?
diagnosed_gaps: Retained item100 responses were buried after implementation detail
Masked loss was general before a reader could trace an actual word and END
Low-rank restriction had equations but little causal picture
changes: Moved exact Base/Full400/LoRA raw response block forward with fixed-item rule intact
Added explicitly generic signal-flow Mermaid distinct from actual roots
Worked two-target NLL and logit gradients using canonical helper
Removed END in a controlled arithmetic variant
Explained low-rank directions and zero-B versus zero-both initialization with matrix derivatives
reuse: Original native assistant generation responses.jsonl records and120-item panel
chapters.controlled_change: Mask only END; double the surviving gradient denominator effect. Set both adapter factors zero: both gradients zero
limitations: Three-outcome arithmetic is separate from symbolic22-ID and Qwen vocabularies
END supervision was present in actual LoRA recipe; the broken variant does not explain its measured failure
Fixed recipe does not isolate rank, target modules or learning rate as cause

chapters.question: What can a comparison tell us that a demonstration cannot?
diagnosed_gaps: Margin definition lacked a fully worked preference update
Shortcut experiment described confounding without showing the actual identifying failure
changes: Connected demonstrations to pairwise relations
Derived stable BCE/softplus identity
Worked existing0.4/−0.6 scores and controlled hard-to70/30 label change
Added additive contradiction for a scalar preference cycle
Explained fresh-response reward use and endpoint head
Promoted retained confounded/balanced coefficients, adversarial probability and length sweep
chapters.controlled_change: Hold the score leaves fixed and change target from hard winner to0.7; hold quality/format fixed and vary length in existing sweep
limitations: Synthetic quality/length/format are authored coordinates, not inferred real-story features
Preference probability is not success probability
Shared-network score movement need not equal independent leaf movement

chapters.question: Can pair odds improve while both answers become less likely?
diagnosed_gaps: Stationarity→exponential tilt skipped the shared multiplier and normalization steps
Reference and beta roles needed a concrete distribution
Third-answer likelihood shift was named without a worked main-text counterexample
changes: Expanded stationarity, exponentiation and normalization derivation
Promoted Day17 exact three-answer optimum and beta sweep
Explained offline four-score update and remaining judgment dependence
Worked preserved solution5 probabilities as a constructed three-answer counterexample
Distinguished bounded likelihoods from divergent separable margins and original reference from old behavior
reuse: Day17 reference(.6,.3,.1), rewards(0,.5,1), beta=.5 stationarity/gauge checks
chapters.controlled_change: Increase fixed-reward beta from.5 to1; hold third-answer mass fixed to show why absolute chosen decrease then becomes impossible
limitations: Constructed vectors are not an observed optimizer path
Finite unrestricted optimum does not certify neural training restraint
Frozen reference does not prevent separable pair margin divergence

chapters.question: What does the student actually learn from a teacher?
diagnosed_gaps: Selection was disconnected from the student objective
Hard/soft target distinction and temperature scale needed a worked gradient comparison
Prefix/context/loss geometry were correct but dense
Tail decomposition skipped its conditional-factorization step
changes: Connected assistant delivery, selection and changed student weights
Compared one selected token with existing teacher(2,.5,−1) distribution
Added concentrated-student correction and temperature target table
Expanded log-softmax-to-KD gradient step and unscaled comparison
Promoted existing fit plot and prefix/context structure diagram
Added authored wrong-prefix ordinary-versus-hint next-token example
Explained unrestricted forward/reverse common minimum and constrained compromises
Expanded tail conditional decomposition
reuse: Day26/05 existing wrong-prefix and tail fixtures
chapters.controlled_change: Keep teacher fixed, concentrate student(.9,.05,.05); remove temperature-square scaling; change only teacher hint at fixed wrong prefix
limitations: Soft probabilities do not guarantee semantic similarity or correctness
Teacher hint does not erase already emitted wrong token
Both unrestricted categorical KL directions minimize at equality
Visited-state conditional gradients do not include student occupancy gradients
No new model-scale transfer or generation evidence
